source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 24 exercise hal (PDF 132-133): 10 MCQs key ke saath, 11 short, 3 constructed response (reaction sequences) aur 4 long sawalon ke model jawab, Kitab ki ghalti aur Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 24 (Organic Nitrogen Compounds) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ka sahi jawab wajah ke saath diya gaya hai; short, constructed response aur long sawalon ke model jawab hain, structures lafzon aur condensed formulas mein. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi.
Q1. Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
I. Primary, secondary and tertiary amine are regarded as:
(Primary, secondary aur tertiary amines kya samjhe jaate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aik hi molecular formula ki amines, maslan C₃H₉N: CH₃CH₂CH₂NH₂ (1°, –NH₂), CH₃CH₂NHCH₃ (2°, >NH) aur (CH₃)₃N (3°, >N–), mein mukhtalif amino groups hain, is liye 1°, 2° aur 3° amines functional group isomers samjhe jaate hain.

blocks.prompt:
II. General formula for secondary amines is:
(Secondary amines ka general formula kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Secondary amine mein do alkyl/aryl groups –NH– se jude hote hain: R–NH–R (R₂NH). RNH₂ primary, R₃N tertiary aur RCONH₂ amide hai.

blocks.prompt:
III. Which one of the following bases is a strongest one?
(In mein se sab se taqatwar base kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Basicity N par lone pair ki dastyabi par munhasir hai. Electron dene wale alkyl groups (+I) ise barhate hain: diethylamine mein do ethyl groups, ethylamine mein aik (pKb 3.29), ammonia mein koi nahi (pKb 4.75). Phenylamine (pKb 9.38) mein lone pair ring mein phail jata hai. Is liye diethylamine sab se taqatwar base hai (is ki value chapter ke table se aage hai).

blocks.prompt:
IV. Acid hydrolysis if nitriles produces:
(Nitriles ki acid hydrolysis se kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nitrile ko dilute acid ke saath garam karne se carboxylic acid banta hai: CH₃CN + 2H₂O + HCl → CH₃COOH + NH₄Cl.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: “if nitriles” ghalat chhapa hai; “of nitriles” hona chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
V. phenyl amine areacts with aqueous Br to form:
(Phenyl amine aqueous bromine se kya banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: –NH₂ ring ko activate karta hai aur ortho aur para positions ki taraf bhejta hai, is liye teeno jagah aik saath bromination hoti hai: C₆H₅NH₂ + 3Br₂ → C₆H₂Br₃NH₂ (2,4,6-tribromophenylamine, safed ppt) + 3HBr.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal ghalat chhapa hai: “areacts” ki jagah reacts, aur “aqueous Br” ki jagah aqueous Br₂ (bromine water) hona chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
VI. Benzenediazonium chloride reacts with phenol in NaOH to form:
(Benzenediazonium chloride NaOH mein phenol se react kar ke kya banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh coupling reaction hai: diazonium ion (electrophile) halke alkaline solution mein phenol ki para position par aata hai aur p-hydroxyazobenzene (orange azo compound) banta hai jis mein –N=N– group hai: C₆H₅N₂⁺Cl⁻ + C₆H₅OH → C₆H₅–N=N–C₆H₄OH + HCl.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Option (a) “Phenyl hydrozine” ghalat chhapa hai; sahi phenylhydrazine hai (har haal mein ghalat option).

blocks.prompt:
VII. What is the structure of an azo compound:
(Azo compound ka structure kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Azo compounds mein do groups ko jorne wala –N=N– (azo) group hota hai: R₁–N=N–R₂ (maslan Ph–N=N–Ph). R₁–NH–R₂ secondary amine, R–O–R ether aur R–C≡N nitrile hai.

blocks.prompt:
VIII. When diazonium salt is heated with water, the gas evolved is:
(Diazonium salt ko pani ke saath garam karne par kaun si gas nikalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: C₆H₅N₂⁺Cl⁻ + H₂O → (garmi) C₆H₅OH + N₂ + HCl. Nitrogen gas nikalti hai aur phenol banta hai.

blocks.prompt:
IX. An aqueous solution of glycine is neutral because of the formation of:
(Glycine ka aqueous solution neutral kyun hota hai? Kis ke banne ki wajah se?)
blocks.explanation: –COOH ka proton –NH₂ par chala jata hai aur dipolar zwitterion H₃N⁺–CH₂–COO⁻ (andaruni salt) banta hai jis ka aik sira positive aur aik negative hai, is liye majmooi charge nahi.

blocks.prompt:
X. Which amines are produced by the reduction of amides?
(Amides ki reduction se kaun si amines banti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Amides (–CONH₂) dry ether mein LiAlH₄ se primary amines mein reduce hote hain: CH₃CONH₂ + 4[H] → CH₃CH₂NH₂ + H₂O. (N-substituted amides se secondary amines banti hain.)

blocks.prompt:
a) Give two preparations of phenyl amine
Phenyl amine banane ke do tareeqe likhein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Nitrobenzene ki Sn aur conc. HCl se reduction: C₆H₅NO₂ + 6[H] → C₆H₅NH₂ + 2H₂O
2. Chlorobenzene ki ammonolysis: C₆H₅Cl + 2NH₃ → (Cu₂O, 250 °C, 50 atm) C₆H₅NH₂ + NH₄Cl
(Benzamide ka Br₂ aur NaOH ke saath Hofmann reaction bhi.)

blocks.prompt:
b) Give two preparations of secondary amines.
Secondary amines banane ke do tareeqe likhein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Primary amine ki halogenoalkane se alkylation (ethanol, pressure): CH₃CH₂Br + CH₃NH₂ → CH₃CH₂NHCH₃ + HBr
2. N-substituted amide ki reduction: CH₃CONHCH₃ + 2H₂ → (Ni/Pt) CH₃CH₂NHCH₃ + H₂O

blocks.prompt:
c) What is the chromophore in azo dyes? What is its function in dyes?
Azo dyes mein chromophore kya hai? Dyes mein is ka kaam kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Chromophore azo group, –N=N– (jaise Ph–N=N–Ph), hai. Yeh dye ke gehre rang ka zimmedar hai; rang (peela, orange, laal, neela ya hara) benzene rings se jude doosre groups par munhasir hai.

blocks.prompt:
d) Why amides are less basic than ammonia.
Amides ammonia se kam basic kyun hain?
blocks.explanation: Amide mein nitrogen ka lone pair C=O ki oxygen ki taraf phail jata hai (resonance), jis se C–N bond mein partial double-bond character aata hai. Lone pair H⁺ lene ke liye kam dastyab hai, is liye amides bohat kamzor base hain aur pani mein neutral solution dete hain.

blocks.prompt:
e) What is zwitter ion?
Zwitter ion kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Zwitterion aisa dipolar ion hai jis ke aik hi molecule mein positive aur negative sire hon, is liye majmooi charge nahi. α-amino acid mein proton –COOH se –NH₂ par jata hai: H₃N⁺–CH(R)–COO⁻ (andaruni salt); maslan glycine, H₃N⁺–CH₂–COO⁻.

blocks.prompt:
f) Differentiate between primary, secondary & tertiary amines.
Primary, secondary aur tertiary amines mein farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: In mein farq nitrogen atom se jude alkyl/aryl groups ki tadaad ka hai (darja N par shakh se tay hota hai, carbon par nahi).

rows: Hal pazeer nitrite salt; koi nishani nahi

blocks.prompt:
g) Write names & structures of four isomeric amines having the molecular formula C₃H₉N.
C₃H₉N ke chaar isomeric amines ke naam aur structures likhein.
blocks.explanation:
1. CH₃CH₂CH₂NH₂: propan-1-amine (1°)
2. CH₃CH(NH₂)CH₃: propan-2-amine (1°)
3. CH₃CH₂NHCH₃: N-methylethanamine (2°)
4. (CH₃)₃N: N,N-dimethylmethanamine (3°)

blocks.prompt:
h) Convert ethanamine into methanamine.
Ethanamine ko methanamine mein badlein.
blocks.explanation:
Aakhir mein Hofmann reaction se aik carbon kam kiya jata hai:
CH₃CH₂NH₂ → (NaNO₂/HCl; N₂ nikalti hai) CH₃CH₂OH → (acidified K₂Cr₂O₇, reflux) CH₃COOH → (SOCl₂) CH₃COCl → (NH₃) CH₃CONH₂ → (Br₂ + 4NaOH) CH₃NH₂
Aakhri qadam: CH₃CONH₂ + Br₂ + 4NaOH → CH₃NH₂ + 2NaBr + Na₂CO₃ + 2H₂O (unstable alkyl diazonium salt se alcohol banna chapter se aage hai).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Hofmann reaction hamesha amide se aik carbon kam wali amine deta hai. Is liye 2 carbon wali amine se 1 carbon wali amine banane ke liye pehle 2 carbon wala amide (ethanamide) banana parta hai.

blocks.prompt:
i) How will you synthesize ethanal from ethanenitrile?
Ethanenitrile se ethanal kaise banayenge?
blocks.explanation:
CH₃CN + 2H₂O + HCl → (garmi) CH₃COOH + NH₄Cl (acid hydrolysis)
CH₃COOH + 4[H] → (LiAlH₄) CH₃CH₂OH + H₂O
CH₃CH₂OH + [O] → (acidified K₂Cr₂O₇; bante hi distil) CH₃CHO + H₂O

blocks.prompt:
j) Define peptide bond. How many peptide bonds are there in a tripeptide?
Peptide bond ki tareef karein. Tripeptide mein kitne peptide bonds hain?
blocks.explanation: Peptide bond (peptide link) woh amide bond, –CO–NH–, hai jo aik amino acid ke –COOH aur doosre ke –NH₂ ke condensation se banta hai aur pani ka molecule nikalta hai. Tripeptide (teen amino acids) mein do peptide bonds hote hain.

blocks.prompt:
k) Give all the tripeptides that could possibly be synthesized from glycine (Gly), alanine (Ala).
Glycine (Gly) aur alanine (Ala) se ban sakne wale tamam tripeptides likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Teeno jagah Gly ya Ala ho sakta hai, is liye 2³ = 8 tripeptides (–NH₂ wale sire se likhe):
Gly-Gly-Gly, Gly-Gly-Ala, Gly-Ala-Gly, Ala-Gly-Gly, Gly-Ala-Ala, Ala-Gly-Ala, Ala-Ala-Gly, Ala-Ala-Ala
In mein se chhe mein dono amino acids hain (Gly-Gly-Gly aur Ala-Ala-Ala ke ilawa).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Gly-Ala aur Ala-Gly mukhtalif peptides hain, kyun ke aik ka azad –NH₂ glycine par aur doosre ka alanine par hota hai. Is liye tarteeb badalne se naya tripeptide banta hai.
Q3. Constructed Response Questions (soch kar jawab likhein)
Compounds ke structures de kar darj zail reaction sequences mukammal karein.

blocks.prompt:
a) 1, 3, 5-tribromobenzene from benzene.
benzene → (HNO₃/H₂SO₄) (A) → (Sn/HCl) (B) → (Br₂ (excess)/FeBr₃) (C) → (NaNO₂/HCl) (D) → (H₃PO₂, −N₂) (E)
Benzene se 1,3,5-tribromobenzene: A se E tak compounds batayein.
blocks.explanation:
A = nitrobenzene, C₆H₅NO₂ (nitration)
B = phenylamine, C₆H₅NH₂ (reduction: C₆H₅NO₂ + 6[H] → C₆H₅NH₂ + 2H₂O)
C = 2,4,6-tribromophenylamine, C₆H₂Br₃NH₂: –NH₂ Br ko dono ortho aur para positions par bhejta hai jo aapas mein meta hain (sirf bromine water kaafi hai; FeBr₃ ki zaroorat nahi)
D = 2,4,6-tribromobenzenediazonium chloride, C₆H₂Br₃N₂⁺Cl⁻ (10 °C se kam par diazotisation)
E = 1,3,5-tribromobenzene, C₆H₃Br₃: H₃PO₂ –N₂⁺ ko H se badalta hai aur N₂ nikalti hai (yeh qadam chapter se aage hai). Teen Br atoms 1, 3 aur 5 positions par reh jaate hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Chaal yeh hai: –NH₂ group Br ko 2, 4, 6 par le aata hai, phir –NH₂ ko diazonium bana kar hata diya jata hai. Is tarah Br atoms aapas mein 1, 3, 5 (meta) par reh jaate hain jo benzene ki seedhi bromination se nahi milte.

blocks.prompt:
b) 1, 3, 5-Tribromobenzene from benzene.
benzene ring → (HNO₃/H₂SO₄) (A) → (Cl₂/FeCl₃) (B) → (Sn/HCl) (C) → (NaNO₂/HCl) (D) → (H₂O, −N₂) (E)
Diye gaye reagents ke mutabiq A se E tak compounds batayein.
blocks.explanation:
A = nitrobenzene, C₆H₅NO₂
B = 3-chloronitrobenzene, ClC₆H₄NO₂: –NO₂ aane wale Cl ko meta position par bhejta hai (chapter se aage)
C = 3-chlorophenylamine, ClC₆H₄NH₂ (Sn/HCl –NO₂ ko –NH₂ banata hai)
D = 3-chlorobenzenediazonium chloride, ClC₆H₄N₂⁺Cl⁻ (10 °C se kam par diazotisation)
E = 3-chlorophenol, ClC₆H₄OH (pani ke saath garmi: –N₂⁺ → –OH, N₂ nikalti hai)
Yeh sequence 1,3,5-tribromobenzene nahi deta (Kitab ki ghalti dekhein).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Hissa (b) mein hissa (a) wala unwan, “1, 3, 5-Tribromobenzene from benzene”, dobara chhapa hai, magar is ke reagents (Cl₂/FeCl₃ aur aakhir mein H₂O) se 3-chlorophenol banta hai, 1,3,5-tribromobenzene nahi. Unwan mein 3-chlorophenol hona chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
c) Keep in view the scheme, devise a reaction sequence to prepare 4-Hydroxybenzoic acid from benzene.
Upar wale scheme ki madad se benzene se 4-hydroxybenzoic acid banane ka sequence banayein.
blocks.explanation:
benzene → (CH₃Cl, anhydrous AlCl₃) methylbenzene → (conc. HNO₃/conc. H₂SO₄) 4-nitromethylbenzene (2-isomer se alag kar ke) → (acidified KMnO₄, garmi) 4-nitrobenzoic acid → (Sn/HCl) 4-aminobenzoic acid → (NaNO₂/HCl, 10 °C se kam) 4-carboxybenzenediazonium chloride → (H₂O, garam, −N₂) 4-hydroxybenzoic acid, HO–C₆H₄–COOH
Tarteeb: –CH₃ o/p ki taraf bhejta hai, is liye nitration oxidation se pehle (–COOH meta ki taraf bhejta); oxidation reduction se pehle taake KMnO₄ –NH₂ ko kharab na kare. (Methylation aur directing effects chapter se aage hain.)

blocks.prompt:
Q4. Describe the relative basicity of aqueous ammonia, ethyl amine and phenyl amine.
Aqueous ammonia, ethyl amine aur phenyl amine ki nisbati basicity bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Ammonia aur amines base hain kyun ke nitrogen ka lone pair proton leta hai. Pani mein yeh thoda react kar ke OH⁻ ions dete hain (halke alkaline solutions):
NH₃ + H₂O ⇌ NH₄⁺ + OH⁻ (pKb = 4.75)
CH₃CH₂NH₂ + H₂O ⇌ CH₃CH₂NH₃⁺ + OH⁻ (pKb = 3.29)
C₆H₅NH₂ + H₂O ⇌ C₆H₅NH₃⁺ + OH⁻ (pKb = 9.38)
Kb jitna zyada (pKb jitna kam), base utna taqatwar. Basicity N par lone pair ki dastyabi par munhasir hai.
Ethylamine: ethyl group electron deta hai (+I effect); yeh N par electron density barhata hai, is liye lone pair zyada dastyab hai aur ethylamine (Kb 5.1 × 10⁻⁴) ammonia (Kb 1.8 × 10⁻⁵) se taqatwar base hai.
Phenylamine: nitrogen flat hai aur us ka lone pair p orbital mein hai jo benzene ring ke delocalised π electrons se overlap karta hai. Lone pair ring par phail jata hai aur proton ke liye kam dastyab hai, is liye phenylamine (Kb 4.2 × 10⁻¹⁰) ammonia se bohat kamzor base hai.
Basicity ki tarteeb: ethylamine > ammonia > phenylamine.
Ammonia aur ethylamine lone pair H⁺ ko de kar acids se salts banate hain: NH₃ + HCl → NH₄⁺Cl⁻; CH₃CH₂NH₂ + HCl → CH₃CH₂NH₃⁺Cl⁻.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kb barhe to base taqatwar; pKb barhe to base kamzor. Ethylamine ka pKb (3.29) sab se kam hai, is liye woh sab se taqatwar base hai; phenylamine ka (9.38) sab se zyada, is liye sab se kamzor.

blocks.prompt:
Q5. Give two preparation methods of each of the following.
i) Primary amines  ii) Secondary amines
Primary aur secondary amines dono ke do do tareeqe likhein.
blocks.explanation:
i) Primary amines:
1. Halogenoalkanes aur ammonia se (nucleophilic substitution): zyada ethanolic ammonia high pressure par istemal hoti hai taake main product primary amine ho (halogenoalkane zyada ho to tertiary amine banti hai).
CH₃CH₂Br + NH₃ (zyada) → (ethanol, high pressure) CH₃CH₂NH₂ + HBr
2. Alkanenitriles ki LiAlH₄ (ya H₂/Ni) se reduction:
CH₃CH₂C≡N + 4[H] → (LiAlH₄) CH₃CH₂CH₂NH₂ (propan-1-amine)
(Doosre tareeqe: nitroalkanes ki reduction, CH₃CH₂NO₂ + 3H₂ → (LiAlH₄) CH₃CH₂NH₂ + 2H₂O; amides ki LiAlH₄ se reduction; aur Hofmann reaction, CH₃CONH₂ + Br₂ + 4NaOH → CH₃NH₂ + 2NaBr + Na₂CO₃ + 2H₂O, jo aik carbon kam wali amine deta hai.)
ii) Secondary amines:
1. Primary amine ki alkylation: halogenoalkane primary amine se ethanol mein pressure par react karta hai.
CH₃CH₂Br + CH₃NH₂ → (ethanol) CH₃CH₂NHCH₃ (N-methylethanamine) + HBr
2. N-substituted amides ki reduction:
CH₃CONHCH₃ (N-methylethanamide) + 2H₂ → (Ni/Pt) CH₃CH₂NHCH₃ + H₂O

blocks.prompt:
Q6. Write a note on electrophoresis.
Electrophoresis par note likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Electrophoresis aisa tareeqa hai jis se mixture mein amino acids ko un ke charge ki bunyad par alag kiya jata hai.
Tareeqa: mixture ke chand qatre filter paper ya gel par lagaye jaate hain jo do electrodes ke darmiyan buffered solution mein rakha hota hai, aur electric field lagaya jata hai.
Usool: har amino acid ka apna isoelectric point (pI) hota hai, yani woh pH jis par us par koi majmooi charge nahi hota (woh zwitterion ki shakal mein hota hai).
• Agar pI > buffer ka pH, to amino acid zyada tar positive hota hai aur cathode (negative electrode) ki taraf jata hai.
• Agar pI < pH, to zyada tar negative hota hai aur anode (positive electrode) ki taraf jata hai.
• Agar pI = pH, to majmooi charge nahi aur woh harkat nahi karta.
pI aur pH ka farq jitna zyada, harkat utni tez. Agar do amino acids ke pI qareeb qareeb hon (maslan glycine aur leucine), to zyada molecular mass wala aahista chalta hai kyun ke charge ko zyada mass uthana parta hai.
Misal (pH 6): lysine (pI 9.74) cathode ki taraf, alanine (pI 6.02) taqreeban apni jagah, aur glutamic acid (pI 3.22) anode ki taraf jata hai.
Pehchan: amino acids be-rang hain, is liye paper par ninhydrin (locating agent) chhirka jata hai jo amino acids se jamni (purple) product deta hai aur spots nazar aa jaate hain.
Istemal: electrophoresis mixture mein amino acids ki tadaad maloom karne ka analytical tareeqa hai; bari miqdar alag nahi kar sakta, us ke liye column chromatography jaise tareeqe istemal hote hain.

blocks.prompt:
Q7. Explain the formation of azo compounds from phenylamine and illustrate the preparation of a dye using this?
Phenylamine se azo compounds banne ki wazahat karein aur is se aik dye ki tayyari dikhayein.
blocks.explanation:
Qadam 1: Diazotisation. Nitrous acid unstable hai, is liye sodium nitrite aur HCl se wahin banaya jata hai, aur mixture barf se 10 °C se kam rakha jata hai:
NaNO₂ + HCl → HNO₂ + NaCl
C₆H₅NH₂ + HNO₂ + HCl → (10 °C se kam) C₆H₅N₂⁺Cl⁻ (benzenediazonium chloride) + 2H₂O
Kam temperature is liye ke diazonium salts room temperature par bhi N₂ de kar toot jaate hain. Aryl diazonium salts kam temperature par kaafi stable hain kyun ke positive charge ring par phail jata hai (alkyl diazonium salts alag nahi kiye ja sakte).
Qadam 2: Coupling. Diazonium ion electrophile hai; yeh bohat activated aromatic compound (halke alkaline solution mein phenol, ya halke acidic mein aromatic amine) se react kar ke para position par aata hai. Product mein –N=N– (azo) group hota hai aur use azo compound kehte hain.
C₆H₅N₂⁺Cl⁻ + C₆H₅OH → (NaOH) C₆H₅–N=N–C₆H₄–OH (p-hydroxyazobenzene, orange solid) + HCl
Mechanism (lafzon mein): –OH ki oxygen ka lone pair ring mein electrons dhakelta hai; para carbon par ring ke π electrons Ph–N≡N⁺ ki aakhri N par hamla karte hain; phir intermediate us carbon se H⁺ khota hai aur ring dobara aromatic ho kar azo compound banta hai.
Dye ki tayyari:
Butter yellow: C₆H₅N₂⁺Cl⁻ + C₆H₅N(CH₃)₂ (N,N-dimethylphenylamine) → (CH₃COOH) (CH₃)₂N–C₆H₄–N=N–C₆H₅ (p-dimethylaminoazobenzene) + HCl. Yeh pehle khane mein istemal hota tha magar cancer paida karne (carcinogenic) ki wajah se ab mamnoo hai.
Isi tarah diazotised sulfanilic acid ko N,N-dimethylphenylamine se couple karne par methyl orange banta hai jo acid–base indicator hai.
Azo group (Ph–N=N–Ph) chromophore hai: yeh dyes ko gehre rang deta hai, peele aur orange se laal, neele aur hare tak, rings par doosre groups ke mutabiq.
